situation: Nothing has been enacted. Live state is empty; no entity, event, or scene exists yet to constrain custody, knowledge, or walking-time. The story exists only as a root and an exposé that already lock the last image: Hetta presents the false village weight unchallenged, tells only Bram she has read the metal, leaves the levy running, and that night the piece tips short against a true work-bar. Two plots are required, each with a because-link into the other. The exposé’s disturbance is the theft of the village weight three weeks before midwinter, and the first causal chain that can be instantiated from that disturbance is the fetch itself.

craft.audience_need: The declared audience is adult, middle reading-level, promised a completed moral choice with a felt cost, an ordinary world, and no last-page rescue. Before they will sit still for a household reckoning about a forty-year lie, they need a job they can count in days and weather and pack-weight. They need to believe, for a stretch of story-time, that the problem is an empty niche and a rite, or the later choice will read as a seminar laid on top of a village. This node must give them the clock, the walk, and the object in her hands — and it must not give them a rescue, a destined fetcher, or a confession that makes the retrieval feel blessed.
craft.genre_convention: Low fantasy with a domestic-drama spine and a craft-mystery turn leads a reader to expect a relic-quest: depart, endure, seize, return, present. This plot satisfies the recovery and deliberately refuses the quest-shape. The taking is a hard walk and a bargain or a modest theft from hungry people, not a raid on evil. The mystery convention is honoured inside this plot rather than split off: the object must be readable as wrong by ordinary metallurgy — quench-line, bloom, stamp-date — before anyone confesses. Wonder, prophecy, and a Dark-Lord antagonist are refused. The Hold remains a compact, not a villain’s face.
craft.theme_and_style: Theme demands that true weight versus false weight be planted in metal, pack, tithe, and debt, and that she think in work, not in named morals. Register is vernacular and filmable: later scenes will have to carry this plot in slug lines, action, and speech, so this spine may not depend on unphotographable interiority. Forbidden tics to keep off the spine: prophetic cadence, she-did-not-know-then, weather as moral weather, quest diction, invented glossary words, a closing thaw as absolution. Magic may appear only as the levy already being paid; it cannot retrieve the piece, identify the fake, or spare anyone the rite. Because the medium is a dialogue-led screenplay, the plot’s turns must be ones people can say, pointedly fail to say, or put on a balance in front of another body.
craft.dramatic_function: This is the A-plot: the disturbance-to-deadline chain that makes everyone walk and that delivers the object into the only hands that can read it. It sets the midwinter clock, spends the household’s last spare body, and pays off the jacket promise that she is competent at retrieval. Its turn — she reads the metal on the return — is not this plot’s moral climax; it is the because-link that forces the second plot to open as defence rather than telling. It closes when the steward takes the piece unchallenged. The manner of that closing is not this plot’s to decide.

tension_management.how: Defining this plot starts the only clock the audience has been promised: three weeks, a pass, a rite. Pressure rises by walking-time and by the piece changing meaning in her pack, not by chase. Recovery-tension releases when the steward accepts the object; a second tension — what the acceptance now costs — is left deliberately unpaid so pl-02 has work. The leaving number is mid, not low, because success at the stated goal is also the installation of the lie.

craft.why_now: This plot has to be written first because its disturbance is already the first story-time event the exposé will allow on screen (the empty niche, Olla’s count of days), and because the second required plot cannot begin until a step of this one has put the object in her hands and taught her it is false. If the owing-plot were instantiated first, she would be asked to decide about a lie she has not yet read, which violates both the mystery convention and her own competence: she knows metal before she knows what she owes. No already-written plot constrains a step of this one; the constraint runs forward.

why_not_otherwise.alternative: Make pl-01 the household plot: Hetta decides what she owes Bram, with the theft as background.
why_not_otherwise.rejected_because: She cannot owe a decision about a forgery until craft has shown her the forgery. The audience has been promised retrieval before rite. Starting in the kitchen argument would also strand the midwinter clock as decoration, and it would force omniscient backstory about the famine winter before anyone has a reason to speak it.

why_not_otherwise.alternative: Make Bram the agent: he tries to get the piece back unread and unbroken.
why_not_otherwise.rejected_because: POV is third-limited to the apprentice; a second mind running a plot violates root.pov and the no-second-POV constraint. He also cannot walk the pass. Making him the fetcher would contradict s08–s11 and the rule that the levy keeps him off the high ground.

why_not_otherwise.alternative: Make the raiders the antagonist-plot and the recovery a war or pursuit.
why_not_otherwise.rejected_because: must_avoid names raiders-as-primary-antagonist. World rules say they are hungry people from poorer slopes, not an army. Thriller score is 18; adventure is 38 and modest. Inflating them would steal the structural antagonist from the Hold compact and spend the event budget on a campaign the story has forbidden.

why_not_otherwise.alternative: Collapse recovery and owing into one plot, since the same woman does both and they share the presentation.
why_not_otherwise.rejected_because: constraints.plot_count is 2 exactly, with at least one because-link in each direction. A single plot cannot constrain itself. Keep_in_mind also requires that pursuing recovery cost the relationship and pursuing the relationship cost the recovery or the rite — that is two pursuits, not one.

why_not_otherwise.alternative: End this plot at the reading, and leave presentation entirely to pl-02.
why_not_otherwise.rejected_because: A recovery plot that does not reach the rite has not faced its stated stake (forfeit of pass and grain-right). The steward’s unchallenged taking is the success condition. What must be reserved for pl-02 is the deliberation of owing, not the public act that the clock demands.

made: Will she bring the piece home before the rite, on foot, with no mount and no second walker.
Why does Bram send her and not go — a question this plot will let her fail to ask.
What does the short seat of the piece against her spine mean, and will craft answer before anyone speaks.
Will the Hold accept the object, and will anyone challenge it in public.
A because-link will spend the chance to hear Bram first, so pl-02 cannot open as a clean confession.
kept: The logline’s and jacket’s promise that a theft puts a fetch on the forge-house and that she is the one who walks it.

psychology.entering_state: Twenty-four, a smith in the work and not in the name, living in the forge-house that raised her from ten. She treats an empty niche as a missing tool with a date attached. She has not yet been forced to decide what she owes the man who taught her; owing, for her, still looks like hours and heat and whether a job was finished.

perception.sight: The niche above the slack-tub is a dark rectangle in sooted plaster, paler at the edges where the piece kept the smoke off. She sees the slack-tub’s scum, the tongs on their hook, Bram’s right hand staying in the apron, Olla in the doorway with the lane’s weather still on her shawl. On the pass later the same eyes will take snow-line, boot-fall, and the colour of a stamp, not vistas.
perception.sound: Olla counting the days left until midwinter in the voice she uses for tithe and burial. The bellows not being pumped. Bram saying she can walk it — a send, not a question. What she will not hear, because no one says it, is why he will not go.
perception.touch: Forge-grit under her heel, the dry cold coming past Olla at the door, later the strap of a pack and the specific wrong mass of the piece against the small of her back. Her hands already know what a true bar of that size should weigh.
perception.smell: Slack-water gone sour, old coal, wet wool on Olla, the iron-and-oil smell of the house she would know in the dark. The pass will replace this with stone-cold air and unwashed camp-smoke, then give the house-smell back as proof she has returned.
perception.taste: Porridge and the faint metal she always tastes in this kitchen. She will taste snow-melt and hunger on the pass, and she will not notice the house taste again until the night after the rite.
perception.interoception: A whole body, fed enough for Highkettle, twenty-four winters old, ready to spend itself as if spending were the same as paying. No levy in her chest. The pass will put cold into her hands and a hollow under the ribs that she will file as walking-cost, not as omen.
perception.proprioception: Standing where she always stands when a job is being named: weight on the balls of her feet, shoulders already dressing themselves for a pack. She is braced for work, not for a question.
perception.attention: She attends to the niche, the days Olla names, the walking-time, what coal and bread the house can spare her. She fails to notice Bram not looking at the niche. She fails to notice that his right hand does not come out to point. She fails to notice her own unasked question as a fact about the job.

appraisal.value_at_stake: Work finished on its date, and the lane’s winter grain — which she holds as a practical value, like not letting a weld fail, not as piety toward the Hold.
appraisal.moral_reading: The niche is empty. Someone has to walk. She has the legs and the craft. Putting the fetch on this house was correct; putting the walk on her is how a forge-house works. She does not yet read the sending as a use of her.
appraisal.somatic_marker: A lift through the shoulders and a set in the jaw that she would call getting ready; heat in the face she will not name as being chosen.

norms_in_force: The house that keeps the iron takes the fetch when the iron is gone.
The younger body walks; the elder keeps the fire.
You do not question a master in front of the lane.
The village weight is not stock; you do not haggle it or leave it in a pack overnight if you can help it.
The midwinter compact is not optional and is not to be spoken of as a cheat in the open.
social_norms.how_others_would_judge: Olla and anyone in the doorway would judge acceptance as due and silence as manners. A refusal, or a public why-won’t-you-go, would be read as the apprentice making standing out of a hungry week.
social_norms.how_absent_others_would_judge: The lane would say the forge-house was named and someone went; that is the whole of virtue. The Hold would not care who walked so long as a piece and a tithe arrive. The dead of the famine winter are Bram’s audience, not hers — she does not feel them yet.
social_norms.standing_at_risk: If she fails the fetch she is the apprentice who lost the lane a year. If she succeeds she is still not named smith, but she is the body the house could spare. Her standing inside the house, not in the lane, is what she can actually lose.
social_norms.norm_conflict: Duty to go without making a scene conflicts with the craft-norm that you ask about a piece before you walk it into winter — what it weighs, what will crack it, why this pair of hands. At the sending, manners win. On the return, craft wins, and that reversal is the plot’s turn.

theory_of_mind.d1: He is the master who raised her at the anvil. He is sending her because he is older and she has the walking years, the way he has always put the long carry and the late quench on her. The empty niche is village business he is putting in her hands as he puts tongs in her hands.
theory_of_mind.d2: He believes she is good enough to bring it back, and that she will still take a send without turning it into a question of her name on the house.
theory_of_mind.d3: He believes she believes the village weight is inherited iron — a tool of the compact, not a piece of his making — and that she believes he is only tired, or keeping the master’s privilege of the fire.
theory_of_mind.accuracy: Wrong on the cause of the sending and on what he fears. She has no model of a levy in his breath and hand, and no model of the piece as his early work. The error will cost the last hour in which his reasons could have arrived as a telling. By the time she knows, the walk will have spent that hour, and anything he says will land as defence.

theory_of_mind.d1: Olla is doing the lane’s counting: days, whose house holds the iron, who can be named where people hear it. She is not asking a favour.
theory_of_mind.d2: Olla believes the forge-house will make the fetch because that is where the iron lives, and believes Hetta is Bram’s hands.
theory_of_mind.d3: Olla believes Hetta believes this is the honour of the house, or at least the work that keeps grain coming, and that she will not make the lane watch a quarrel.
theory_of_mind.accuracy: Wrong that Hetta hears honour. Hetta hears a date. The cost inside this plot is small: Olla will get her fetch. The cost later is that Olla, and the lane she speaks for, will never be told the metal is false.

theory_of_mind.d1: Hungry people from poorer slopes who took metal because the Hold’s protection does not cover them. Not an army. They will have a price, or a gap in the watch, or both.
theory_of_mind.d2: They believe the piece is worth grain or trade-iron, and that Highkettle will come with more than one walker if it comes at all.
theory_of_mind.d3: They believe Highkettle believes the Hold will punish the theft, and so they believe she may come speaking the Hold’s name as a threat.
theory_of_mind.accuracy: She may overestimate how much they know about what they hold, and how carefully they watch a single stamped weight. The error can cost her a harder taking than she needs, or a bargain that offers the Hold’s anger they already live outside. It will not cost her the piece if she stays practical.

urges.cravings: Warmth at the slack-tub, a full bowl before she goes, the specific satisfaction of a tool returned to its place. On the pass: salt, fat, any heat that is not her own muscle.
urges.physical_needs: At the opening, sleep and food enough. Across the walk: heat, calories, dry feet, the rest the three-week clock will not fully allow. An untreated deep cold in the hands by the return.
urges.psych_needs_conscious: To treat the empty niche as a job and close it. To be the pair of hands that does, so no one can say the house failed the lane.
urges.psych_needs_unconscious: To be sent. To have him say she can walk it, which is the closest the house comes to naming her smith. She would deny that the send is a gift.
urges.avoidances: Asking why he will not go. Standing in the doorway making the lane watch them. Any framing of the walk as what she is owed or what she owes. Looking at his right hand long enough for it to become a question.

impairments.physical: None at the sending. Across the middle of the plot: cold, caloric debt, broken sleep, the ordinary damage of a high pass in the three weeks before midwinter. No wound that stops the work.
impairments.magical: none — the levy is not on her. That absence is itself a fact she fails to use as information.
impairments.coercive: Olla’s public putting of the fetch on the house; Bram’s send; the compact’s forfeit if no piece arrives; the village’s inability to buy a replacement, hire a second walker, or meet a punitive tithe.
impairments.cognitive: She cannot currently think of owing as anything but work-hours and finished jobs. She cannot think why a master would not walk his own iron. The frame is the impairment.
impairments.net_effect: She is fully capable of the walk, the taking, and the reading. She is not capable, at the sending, of asking the question that would have made the recovery also a conversation. Competence and this blindness travel together; the plot uses both.

deliberation.framing: An empty niche is a fetch with a walking-time. The error in the frame is treating a compact-object as a tool to be returned, which hides the questions (why this house, why this walker, why will he not go, what will crack it) that would have belonged to the job if the piece were only iron.

options_weighed.option: Accept the send and walk it alone on the days they have.
options_weighed.predicted_outcome: The piece comes home if her legs and the camp allow it; the lane keeps its year.
options_weighed.cost: Her body on the pass; the house without her hands for those days; whatever she does not ask before she goes.

options_weighed.option: Ask him, in the forge, why he will not go.
options_weighed.predicted_outcome: He will give age, or the fire, or a silence that makes Olla shift in the door. Unlikely she gets a true reason in front of the lane.
options_weighed.cost: Manners broken; she looks as if she is refusing the send; she still has to walk.

options_weighed.option: Refuse and let Olla put the fetch on another house.
options_weighed.predicted_outcome: Someone less able to read metal, or more willing to break a stuck clasp, walks it. The piece may not come home whole.
options_weighed.cost: The forge-house’s standing; her own standing in the only place she has a name of any kind.

options_weighed.option: Ask for a second walker or a mount.
options_weighed.predicted_outcome: Olla will say what they already know: the village has neither to spare.
options_weighed.cost: Time in the doorway, and the look that she does not know the house’s books.

deliberation.reasoning: Days left, walking-time over the high pass, bread and coal the house can pull from the winter stack, weight she can carry, hands that know a stamp from a bruise. Other houses have legs; this house has the iron’s habits. A second pair of feet is a second mouth to feed on the path. Asking why he stays is a question for after the piece is back, if it is a question at all. The job is the date.
deliberation.chosen_because: It is the option that treats the niche as work, keeps manners in front of Olla, and uses the only surplus the house has, which is her. She is good at this kind of choosing.
deliberation.known_unknowns: Where the camp sits on the poorer slopes; whether they will sell, trade, or only lose the piece if it is taken; the weather on the high miles; whether the piece is already scarred. She hedges with food she can carry, with days left unspent at each end, and with the intention to check the piece for travel-damage before she sleeps on it — a craft habit that will, without her planning it, open the turn.

control.felt: Readiness, a small heat at being the one named, a work-anxiety about days and weather, and a question she has not let become words.
control.expressed: Acceptance. Practical questions about bread, coal, and when she leaves. A nod to Olla. No why.
control.divergence_reason: Manners, and the habit of not making the house watch her want things — including wanting the send, including wanting a reason. Alignment would look like a child.
control.leakage: She does not look at his right hand. She does not look long at the niche once the send is spoken. The unasked why is audible to anyone who came to hear a bargain and hears only packing. Bram will misread that silence as safety.
control.inhibited_impulse: To ask why he will not go. To have him say she is smith enough that the house can stand her gone.

psychology.intention: Bring the village weight home before the rite, whole enough to present, and close the job.
psychology.action: Across the plot she accepts the send, walks the pass alone, takes the piece from people who need metal or a bargain for grain, feels it sit short against her spine, reads quench-line and bloom and a stamp forty years too young while checking for travel-damage, comes home already knowing, and — under a choice this plot does not own — presents the piece at the midwinter ground without a public challenge.

trajectory.shift: From worker in an ordinary winter to the body the house is spending on a dated job. Pride lands; the question does not.
trajectory.trigger: Olla putting the fetch on the forge-house and Bram saying she can walk it.

state_delta.from: apprentice of a house that keeps iron
state_delta.to: named walker of the fetch

trajectory.shift: The job becomes flesh: cold, hunger, time counted in how she stands at night. She is still inside the job-frame.
trajectory.trigger: The high miles with no mount, no second walker, and a physiological bill the village cannot pay for her.

state_delta.to: pass-spent: caloric debt, cold in the hands, sleep broken

trajectory.shift: She gets custody of the object from people who needed it. Competence confirmed. The piece is still, in her mind, the village’s iron.
trajectory.trigger: A bargain or a modest theft at the poorer-slope camp — need meeting need, not a battle.

state_delta.to: carrying the village weight in the pack

trajectory.shift: Craft attention snags. The job-frame first cracks as a problem of mass, not of morals.
trajectory.trigger: The piece sits short against her spine on the return, short of the mass her hand expects for a bar of that size.

state_delta.from: the object is the inherited village weight
state_delta.to: the object’s mass is wrong; travel-damage must be checked

trajectory.shift: She knows it is his early work before anyone confesses. Recovery is still the goal; the object is no longer the object she was sent for. The chance to hear him first is already spent.
trajectory.trigger: Quench-line, bloom, and a stamp forty years too young, read the way he taught her to read any suspect bar.

state_delta.to: certain it is Bram’s forty-year forgery

trajectory.shift: She completes the stated goal. The steward takes the piece. She is the fetcher who kept the lane its year, and she is no longer only that. The job-frame cannot be put back.
trajectory.trigger: The midwinter presentation ground; the steward’s unchallenged taking; Bram standing behind her still paying.

state_delta.to: the one who brought the weight back in time

psychology.leaving_state: The fetch is done. Her body has paid the pass. Her craft has paid her in knowledge she did not walk out to buy. She has succeeded at the goal this plot gave her, and the goal has changed under her hands into a known-false weight delivered on time. What she does with owing is not settled here.
psychology.unresolved: What she owes him, what she owes the lane that will eat the year in ignorance, whether presenting an unbroken forgery is work or a second forging. Those belong to pl-02. Also unresolved inside this plot: whether she was right to go unasking — a practical question she will only be able to see after his reasons arrive as defence.

psychology.entering_state: The bound smith. Forty years ago he forged the piece that sits — until tonight — in the niche, and he has paid in breath, warmth, and the right hand ever since. He raised her from ten. He has never found a year when telling seemed cheaper than silence. The theft is the first year the silence may not be able to buy.

perception.sight: The same empty niche, which he has looked at every working day for forty years and which he now cannot look at while Olla is in the door. Hetta’s face doing what it does with a job. His own right hand, thicker, slower, kept in the apron. He sees whether her eyes go to the plaster-edge or to him.
perception.sound: Olla’s count of days, which he already knew in his chest. Hetta’s practical questions about bread and leaving-time. The thing he does not hear and is listening for: why won’t you go.
perception.touch: The constant not-enough-warmth in the bound hand; the forge-heat that no longer fills him the way it fills her. He will touch nothing of the piece until it is home, if then.
perception.smell: The house-smell that means the levy is still being paid in the place he made the lie. He knows this smell as work. He does not let it become the famine winter.
perception.taste: Metal at the back of the mouth that is the levy as much as the work. He has stopped noticing it except on days like this.
perception.interoception: Short breath. A cold that is not the door. The right hand as a bill, not as a tool. Fear sits in the same place as the short breath; he cannot always tell them apart.
perception.proprioception: Planted in the house. The pass is a direction his body has already been forbidden. He is braced to send, not to walk.
perception.attention: He attends to whether she will ask, whether Olla will put another name on the walk, whether the piece will be broken in poorer hands or read by them. He fails to attend to the fact that he taught her quench, bloom, and the age of a stamp, and that a soundness-check on a return walk is exactly those three things.

appraisal.value_at_stake: The lane’s year (grain, open pass), the piece unbroken so the levy still binds, and the silence that has been, in his accounting, the kindness that fed children and then fed her.
appraisal.moral_reading: Sending her untold is the only path that does not put the piece in hands that might break it, or in his hands that cannot make the miles, or in her ears in a week when telling would be another use of the child he kept. He can still hear the famine reasons. He cannot defend the forty years. He does not try, even inwardly, on this morning; he tries to get the iron home.
appraisal.somatic_marker: The levy-cold sharpening in the right hand and a catch high in the chest before any sentence about walking forms.

norms_in_force: The house that keeps the iron answers for it.
A master does not send a child onto a pass he could walk himself — unless he cannot.
You do not speak a compact-cheat in front of the lane or the Hold.
You do not make an apprentice carry a truth that will not feed her.
Younger walks, elder keeps the fire — the cover-norm he will use.
social_norms.how_others_would_judge: Olla would judge the send as ordinary if he plays age and the fire. She would judge a confession in that doorway as the forge-house breaking the lane’s year with its mouth. Hetta would judge the send as trust if she is not given a reason to judge it as use.
social_norms.how_absent_others_would_judge: The lane would call any public truth about the piece a vanity that starves them. The Hold would not come unless the object were challenged or broken; then it would close the pass. The dead of that famine winter — the only audience he has let sit in the house for forty years — would, in his fear, call telling a waste of the three nights he already spent.
social_norms.standing_at_risk: Master of the forge-house; keeper of the piece; the man who raised her. If the piece is broken or publicly challenged he loses the compact for the lane and the last justification of the levy. If she reads it he loses the right to have the story be a telling.
social_norms.norm_conflict: Keep the lane in grain versus do not use the woman you raised. Keep the piece unread versus do not send her blind onto a pass with iron that is also a binding. The compact-and-silence pair wins at the sending. It will not survive her return intact.

theory_of_mind.d1: She will walk it, take it, and bring it home as stock. She reads metal for soundness, not for parentage. She is still, in the part of him that chose silence when she was ten, the child he did not put a famine year onto.
theory_of_mind.d2: She thinks he is keeping the master’s privilege of the fire and giving her the cold, which is ordinary and a little unfair, and she will not make a scene about it in front of Olla.
theory_of_mind.d3: She thinks he thinks the piece is the old true weight, and she thinks he thinks she is not yet a smith except in the work. She thinks he believes she believes that.
theory_of_mind.accuracy: Wrong that a soundness-check will stop at travel-scars. He taught her the three things that will date the bar. Wrong that she is still the child the silence was for. The error will cost him first voice in the story of the piece. She will come home already knowing, and his reasons will have to arrive as defence.

theory_of_mind.d1: She is the lane’s mouth today. She wants a name on the walk and a date. She does not want a history of the niche.
theory_of_mind.d2: She believes he is old and the house is the right house, and that Hetta is how the house walks.
theory_of_mind.d3: She believes he believes the piece is the piece, and that he believes the fetch is honourably placed.
theory_of_mind.accuracy: Correct enough for this morning. The error is only that he is using her belief as cover. Cost is deferred: Olla will never be told, and her good faith becomes part of what Hetta will later have to carry.

theory_of_mind.d1: They will eat the year if the piece arrives and starve a worse year if it does not. They do not want the inside of the iron explained.
theory_of_mind.d2: They believe the forge-house keeps faith with them. They believe he has always kept it.
theory_of_mind.d3: They believe he believes the compact is honest iron, and that he would not spend their daughter-not-daughter on a lie.
theory_of_mind.accuracy: They are not thinking about him at that resolution; they are thinking about grain. He over-credits their faith and under-credits their hunger. The error lets him keep calling silence kindness.

urges.cravings: The piece back in the niche. Air that is enough. Warmth in the bound hand. A year in which telling still costs more than not.
urges.physical_needs: Breath, heat, the right hand as a working thing — all already taxed by the levy, all made worse by fear. He needs to stay off the pass the way a man with a broken gait needs the flat.
urges.psych_needs_conscious: Hetta gone quickly, without the question, and the piece home unbroken before midwinter.
urges.psych_needs_unconscious: To remain the only reader of the piece. To have the famine winter still count as the reason. To not watch her face while she learns what the house is.
urges.avoidances: The pass. Her looking at his hand. The sentence that begins with the cracked original. Any year, including this one, in which telling becomes the cheaper account.

impairments.physical: The levy’s long tax: less breath on a slope, less warmth in still air, a right hand that will not do fine or long work in the cold. He cannot make the high pass as a walker of this fetch.
impairments.medical: none beyond the levy’s bodily bookkeeping.
impairments.magical: A living bind: breath, warmth, right hand, paid continuously, transferable by nothing available in this story except his death or the piece’s public breaking.
impairments.coercive: The compact; the lane’s hunger; Olla in the door; the fact that other hands might break or read the piece; the forty years already spent, which coerce him more than any person.
impairments.cognitive: He cannot think telling as anything but another use of her, because he first refused to tell when she was a child and the refusal became the shape of care. He cannot think the send as use for the same reason.
impairments.net_effect: He can send, wait, keep the fire, and stand at a presentation. He cannot walk the piece back, cannot supervise how she checks it, and cannot get his reasons to the door before her craft does. The levy and the habit of silence together make her the only walker and the worst possible reader.

deliberation.framing: The problem is how to get the piece home unbroken and unread by anyone who would break the year by speaking. The error in the frame is that ‘unread’ includes her, and she is the only competent walker the house has. He has framed protection of the lane as protection from her eyes.

deliberation.reasoning: The hand will not take that cold for those miles. Other hands do not know what not to do to a quench-line that is also a bind. Telling is a third night he does not have and a use he already refused when she was ten. She walks, she brings stock home, she puts it in the niche, he can breathe until the next midwinter. The account has worked every year that the piece stayed on the plaster.
deliberation.chosen_because: It is the only option that keeps the piece in this house’s story, keeps his body off the pass, and keeps the famine reasons from having to be said in a week when they will sound like a man sending a woman into snow. He knows the old reasons are not defensible now. He sends anyway.
deliberation.known_unknowns: Whether the raiders have already nicked, heated, or tried to recut the piece. Whether she will ask why he will not go. Whether a soundness-check on a cold path stays a soundness-check. He hedges by sending the person least likely to break iron and most likely to bring it home — and does not count that person as a reader.

control.felt: Fear the piece will be broken or dated. Guilt that has had forty years to go quiet and has not. Relief, already, that she is not asking.
control.expressed: She can walk it. Ordinary send. Age and the fire if anyone presses. Practical leave to pack.
control.divergence_reason: A confession in that doorway starves the lane or spends her. The cover-norm (younger walks) is available and true enough to say. He has had decades to practise not showing the levy as anything but age.
control.leakage: The right hand stays in the apron. He does not look at the niche while Olla can see his face. He answers the walk and does not offer to go even as a form. Hetta can read none of this yet because she is not looking; Olla can read a tired master if she cares to.
control.inhibited_impulse: To tell her the piece is his and the walk is a bill. To forbid her to look past scars. To go anyway and fail on the first high mile rather than watch her leave with it unread.

interaction.what_collides: Hetta’s want to close a dated job with the village weight in the niche collides with the winter pass (which will charge her body), with the raiders’ want to keep metal they can eat with, and with Bram’s want that the same recovery happen only along the one path that keeps the piece unbroken and unread — a path that requires her not to ask and him not to walk. She and Bram share the recovery goal and fight over the terms; she and the pass do not share anything; she and the raiders share hunger and not the year.
interaction.power_balance: Olla can put a fetch on a house in public. Bram can send or withhold and can refuse the pass with a body the levy has already forbidden. Hetta has the only walkable body the house can spare and, later, the only craft on the path. The raiders have custody until she takes it. The Hold can close the pass and withhold grain without sending a face. Power shifts when the piece is on her back: office matters less than a thumb on a quench-line. It shifts again at the presentation ground, where only a public challenge can make the Hold look, and she is the person who would have to speak it.
interaction.information_asymmetry: Bram knows the forgery and the levy. Hetta knows walking-time, expected mass, and how to read a bar. The lane knows the niche is empty. The Hold will not inspect unless invited by a break or a challenge. The raiders likely know a useful weight, not a bind. The asymmetry flips on the return walk: she becomes the one who has read the metal, and he does not know that until she is home. That flip is what this plot sells to pl-02.
interaction.turning_point: On the return, the piece sits short against her spine and she checks it for travel-damage. Quench-line, bloom, and a stamp forty years too young tell her it is his before anyone confesses. Recovery remains the goal — the rite is still coming — but the object is no longer the inherited relic she was sent to fetch. From this beat on, every step of the fetch is also a step toward a decision this plot is not allowed to make.

decision.resolution: pl-01 is the recovery plot. Agent: Hetta. Goal: bring the stolen village weight home in time for the midwinter presentation so Highkettle does not forfeit a year of pass-protection and grain-right. Resistance: the winter pass’s physiological bill, village poverty that forbids a mount or second walker, raiders who have custody because they are hungry, the three-week clock, and Bram’s insistence that the only acceptable recovery path is hers and untold. Stake: the lane’s year. Spine: theft from the niche; Olla puts the fetch on the forge-house; Bram sends her and she accepts without asking why he will not go; she walks the pass alone and pays in cold and hunger; she takes the piece by bargain or modest theft; it sits short against her spine; she reads quench, bloom, and a stamp forty years too young; she comes home already knowing (because-link into pl-02); she presents the piece and the steward takes it unchallenged (success; manner caused by pl-02). Termination: success at the stated goal plus transformation of what the goal was — the object she delivers is a known-false weight. No already-written plot constrains a step of this one.
